title: GM makes charging easy while Elon bets big on fossil fuels and Leno talks Tesla
summary: On today’s super simple episode of Quick Charge, we talk about GM’s new Energy Pass, SpaceX’s big bet on fossil fuels, and Tesla’s long-promised Roadster set to arrive “real soon.” Again. For what is nearly the tenth year in a row.

title: Lexus undercuts luxury rivals with 2027 ES prices starting under $50,000
summary: The all-electric 2027 Lexus ES returns for the 2027 model year, with prices starting under $50,000.

title: Here’s our first look at the Range Rover GT in real life [Video]
summary: Range Rover is adding a fifth member to its lineup, but this one is a bit of an outlier. The new GT brings a sharp, fastback design that looks even sportier on the road.

title: Tesla design chief says new Roadster coming ‘very soon’ — sure
summary:
Tesla’s chief designer says the new Roadster is coming “very soon.” We are talking about the same car Tesla revealed in 2017 and promised to build by 2020.

Franz von Holzhausen said it on the latest episode of Jay Leno’s Garage. When Leno pressed him on it, he doubled down: “very soon.” Leno’s deadpan reply, “10 years… just shy of 10 years,” said the rest.

title: Tesla exhausts its California MyFirstEV rebate allocation in 5 days
summary:
Tesla ran through its entire share of California’s new MyFirstEV rebate program in just five days.. The rebate only went live for Tesla buyers on August 3.

Buyers claimed roughly half of Tesla’s allocation in the first three days and drained the rest by August 8, spending an estimated $18 million in state and matching rebates on Tesla vehicles alone.

title: Kia EV3 caught driving in New York as its US launch inches closer [Images]
summary: The EV3 is finally almost here. With its US launch just around the corner, Kia’s electric SUV was captured driving around New York.

title: Tesla unveils first Cybercab with Starlink antenna integrated
summary:
Tesla’s robotaxi account posted photos today of what it’s calling the first Cybercab with a Starlink antenna built into the vehicle.

The pictures show a gold Cybercab parked at Gigafactory Texas, with a low-profile satellite antenna integrated into the roof. It’s the physical version of an integration Tesla teased with a diagram last month.

title: Mercedes teases its upcoming 1,000+hp AMG electric SUV
summary: Mercedes teased a new sport SUV on its AMG social media channels over the weekend, expected to be the SUV counterpart to its bonkers 1,153hp AMG GT 4-door revealed in May.

title: 49ers’ Shanahan crashed his Tesla on Autopilot reaching for his phone
summary:
San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan crashed his Tesla Model S on July 14 while the car was running on Autopilot. He was reaching for a phone that had dropped out of reach, and he took his eyes off the road.

The crash left him with a concussion, a broken nose, three broken ribs, a broken left hand, and 40 stitches over his right eye. And to his credit, he isn’t blaming the car.

title: Ford reveals Fathom EV pickup prices in the US and Canada
summary: Ford’s new electric pickup will go on sale in the US early next year, starting at $28,350. Buyers in Canada won’t have to wait much longer, with pre-orders also set to open in early 2027.

title: Getting your teen a back-to-school e-bike? Don’t forget this cool-looking protective gear
summary:
Back-to-school season often means shopping for backpacks, notebooks, and maybe even a new ride. For a growing number of families, that ride is an electric bike.

And I’m all for it. Giving teenagers the freedom to get themselves to school, sports practice, or a friend’s house without needing a car is one of the best things e-bikes can offer. But just like we’d encourage a new driver to wear a seatbelt, young e-bike riders should be equipped with the right protective gear too.

title: Volvo’s new sedan breaks cover, but it may not be the EV we expected [Images]
summary: Volvo is expected to reenter the segment with an all-new sedan, but it may not be as electric as expected.

title: Archer makes wild deal with Boeing swapping eVTOL startups for equity
summary:
Archer Aviation is buying three of Boeing’s aerospace subsidiaries: autonomous air-taxi developer Wisk Aero, military drone maker Insitu, and airspace-software firm SkyGrid. The deal also hands Boeing a stake in Archer.

Investors loved it. Archer (ACHR) stock jumped more than 20% on Monday, and the acquisition instantly turns a pre-revenue eVTOL startup into a company with a profitable defense business behind it.

It could accelerate Archer’s eVTOL plans.

title: Musk’s Terafab chip plant will run on gas, not Tesla solar
summary:
SpaceX confirmed it will power Terafab, its $16.8 billion chip megafactory in Texas, with its own natural gas power plants and “very large battery arrays.” Tesla solar isn’t in the plan.

That’s despite Tesla being a partner on the project, and despite Tesla selling solar panels, Powerwalls, and grid-scale batteries built for exactly this kind of load.

title: BYD’s kei EV already looks like a hit with over 1,000 orders in its first 2 weeks
summary: BYD’s first electric kei car received over 1,000 orders in just two weeks after it went on sale.

summary: If you’ve spotted one of Monarc’s new e-bikes, there’s a good chance one of your first thoughts was, “Wait… did they install the fork backwards?”

summary: Chinese autonomy experts Pony.ai are planning to put 1,000 autonomous electric commercial trucks to work by 2027, but it’s the company’s plans to put 100,000 self-driving trucks on the road by 2030 that’s making headlines.

title: Paris now requires electric scooter riders to wear high-vis vests or face fines
summary: Paris is getting tougher on electric scooter safety, with new rules now requiring riders to wear both a helmet and a high-visibility vest while using their scooters on public roads.

title: Zero will pay new riders to get on electric motorcycles… just not in the US
summary: Zero Motorcycles has launched a new incentive program that offers cash back to newly licensed riders who purchase one of the company’s electric motorcycles or scooters. It’s an interesting way to encourage new motorcyclists to skip internal combustion and go electric from day one.

title: Sneaky safari: Thula Solutions’ electric 4×4 gets you closer to nature [video]
summary: Thula Solutions’ new electric safari vehicles aren’t repurposed diesels – they were engineered from the ground up as purpose-built electric safari vehicles designed to get curious tourists, scientists, and park workers closer to the action than ever before.

title: Heavy equipment space race heats up with new Vermeer lunar excavator [update]
summary:
International equipment manufacturer Vermeer has unveiled a full-scale prototype of its Interlune excavator, a machine designed to ingest 100 metric tons of rocks and dirt per hour, extracting valuable helium as it makes its way across the surface … of the Moon.

UPDATE 08AUG26: Interlune and Vermeer have expand their partnership.
